programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: It is 1914. As the Great War looms, the mighty Ottoman Empire is crumbling. Constantinople, the once vibrant, multicultural capital on the shores of the Bosporus, is about to be consumed by chaos.

programme.title: The Book of Love
programme.desc: When Penny, the light of Henry's life, is killed in a car crash, he puts everything on hold as he tries to come to terms with his loss. When his bereavement leave is over, everyone expects straight-laced Henry to return to work. But now everything has changed and Henry is not going back.

programme.title: Zookeeper
programme.desc: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence...

programme.title: A Monster Calls
programme.desc: From the director of THE IMPOSSIBLE and the producers of PAN'S LABRYNTH, A MONSTER CALLS is a searing and fantastical story of one boy's journey to confront the truth.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he's left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed. Jillian's plan is to sell the cabin as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can't refuse. Sparks fly as they work together to transform the cabin into a holiday resort. When business doesn't go as planned and she almost loses her newfound family, Jillian needs to make a decision. Will she give up everything for the love she never saw coming?

programme.title: Romance Retreat
programme.desc: After a big breakup, journalist Dana Willingham finds herself alone and stuck at a couple's yoga retreat while the biggest story of her career breaks far away. And she doesn't even like yoga! But maybe the universe has put her here for a reason, because the handsome loner staying at the lodge turns out to be Stefan Gonzales, the tech guru at the center of the scandal. As she gains his trust to expose him, she finds herself falling in love with him. Now she must use the lessons from yoga to choose: the perfect story or the perfect man?

programme.title: Northpole
programme.desc: When a loss of togetherness spreads across the globe and threatens the existence of Santa's Northpole, a little boy named Kevin is called upon to save the day.

programme.title: Arctic Blast
programme.desc: When a solar eclipse sends a colossal blast of super chilled air towards the earth, it then sets off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens to engulf the world in ice and begin a new Ice Age.

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: Lonely Maiden Productions, LLC. All Rights Reserved. Under exclusive license to Signature Entertainment Ltd 2008

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Elektra unwittingly takes part in her former teacher's test when she protects a former target and his daughter from "The Hand," a sinister crime syndicate of martial arts fighters.

programme.title: Prime
programme.desc: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: A crew of miniature aliens operate a spaceship that has a human form

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn
programme.desc: The Quileutes close in on Edward and Bella, whose unborn child poses a threat to the Wolf Pack and Forks.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn
programme.desc: The Cullens gather together other vampire clans in order to protect Renesmee from a false allegation.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: When Bella Swan moves to a small town, she falls in love with Edward Cullen, a 108-year-old vampire.

programme.title: On Angel Wings
programme.desc: One starry night, a shepherd boy is taken on a secret, magical night-flight to witness a Christmas miracle. Rachel is 8 and for the first time is allowed to join her brothers and sister to visit their grandfather, Amos, as he carries out his annual ritual of a night in the hills, where he worked as a young shepherd boy. Grandfather is delighted to see the children and a special bond is established between him and Rachel. He tells them how she reminds him of a magical night he then proceeds to recount it. He explains how, ahead of the other shepherds protecting their flock with him, he is flown away by the Angel Gabriel, to be the first visitor to the newly born Christ child. This magical re-working of the nativity by the leading writer Michael Morpurgo (War Horse, Private Peaceful) is rich with human poignancy as we share this very special experience.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: A brilliantly hilarious "in tents" comedy drama, starring David Arquette, Amy Acker and Academy Award nominee June Squibb. With their marriage on the rocks, Jack and Amanda head off on a glamping trip to "reignite their spark". But when their blissful romantic getaway is hijacked by a pair of hipster honeymooners and a hunky land-owner, they are left in more trouble than before!

programme.title: Mr. Jones
programme.desc: A highly-compelling political thriller from award-winning director Agniezka Holland. Welsh journalist Gareth Jones (James Norton: Little Women) risks his life to expose the truth about the devastating famine in the Soviet Union in the early 1930s. Also starring Vanessa Kirby (The Crown) and Golden Globe Nominee Peter Sarsgaard (The Batman). This is the most important true story you will ever see.

programme.title: Assassin
programme.desc: Danny Dyer (Eastenders) is back on top form in Assassin, a brutal, hard-hitting story of Jamie, a former hitman out for revenge. Starring Martin Kemp (The Krays), Gary Kemp (The World's End), and from the producers of Rise of the Footsoldier and Goodfellas, Assassin is the story of the most corrupt crime bosses in the London underworld, and one man's crusade to bring them to justice.

programme.title: The Contender
programme.desc: This Oscar nominated political White House thriller stars Gary Oldman, Jeff Bridges, Sam Elliot, Christian Slater and Joan Allen. We follow a senior Senator, who is contending for the US Vice Presidency and her fall from grace after accusations about her past surface. Described as a modern political masterpiece and a flawless thriller that educates and entertains all at the same time.

programme.title: Between us
programme.desc: Henry and Dianne fear that settling down means giving up on their dreams. It will take the universe conspiring to keep them apart for them to realize just how much they need each other.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: Ex-felon, Eugene Brown, establishes a Chess Club for inner city teenagers in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: The Great Alaskan Race
programme.desc: During a deadly 1925 outbreak in Alaska, musher Leonhard must cross 700 miles of brutal terrain to deliver life-saving serum. With his son's life at stake, he relies on his sled dogs in a race against time inspired by a true story.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: In 1940s England, thirteen year old Tolly is sent to Green Knowe, the country estate of his grandmother, while his mother searches for any information concerning his missing in action father. Tolly soon finds that he can pass through time to witness the family stories Grandmother Oldknow tells him.

programme.title: The Odyssey (2016)
programme.desc: 1948, Jacques Cousteau, his wife and his two sons are living in paradise, in a beautiful house overlooking the Mediterranean. But all Cousteau can think of is adventure. Thanks to his invention, an independent aqualung allowing divers to breathe under water, he has discovered a whole new world.

programme.title: Marry Me At Christmas
programme.desc: Madeline is used to planning other people's dream weddings.

programme.title: The Christmas Ball
programme.desc: A woman visits her Aunt in England for the holidays where she meets a handsome historian who is determined to promote her Aunt manor as a historical landmark. Starring Deirdre Mullins (2020)

programme.title: A Very Merry Bridesmaid
programme.desc: 2021) Festive romcom starring Emily Osment. It may be Christmas Eve and her brother's wedding too, but can Leah's childhood crush give our overshadowed bridesmaid a 30th birthday to remember?

programme.title: A Merry Christmas Match
programme.desc: (2019) Charming Christmas romance with Ashley Newbrough. After years of working in her mother's small-town antique shop, a woman wonders if she needs something new after meeting a handsome stranger.

programme.title: The Holiday Proposal Plan
programme.desc: (2023) Second-chance romance with Tatyana Ali and Jesse Kove. Sonny and her ex reluctantly team up to get their best friends back together. But will more than one flame be rekindled this Christmas?

programme.title: Just for the Summer
programme.desc: Teacher Penelope Campbell loves visiting her Grandma Dot every summer – despite her constant attempts to find Penelope a man! This year, she bumps into her childhood sweetheart Jason Humphrey, who explains his grandmother is desperate to pair him off, too.

programme.title: Sweet Autumn
programme.desc: Maggie, a successful entrepreneur, returns home for a will reading and discovers she's inherited half of her aunt's famed maple candy business. What she doesn't understand is why Aunt Dee's maple supplier, Dex, inherited the other half.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: Jessica Tucker, a widow and successful doctor, is trying to juggle work and family when she learns she's up for the top job at the hospital.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding
programme.desc: A month before their wedding, on Christmas Day, Emily is called away for business. When Emily is due to return, a major storm hits making it impossible for her to leave. Emily desperately tries to make it home while Ben gets his act together.

programme.title: Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Starring Patrick Swayze and Chris Kattan. Three children and their father move from California to Canada. When they go shopping at the mall, they find counterfeit cash, inadvertently help catch crooks, and make a discovery about Santa.

programme.title: Love Notes
programme.desc: Starring Laura Leighton and Antonio Cupo. When a classical music critic becomes pregnant from a brief encounter with a country music star, she decides it is the perfect way for her infertile best friend to have a baby.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Ball
programme.desc: It's a fairy tale come true for Allison, and her daughter, Lily, when Lily's estranged father, Charles, makes a visit to California. Charles may have come on official business, but his real mission is to find Allison and make amends for lost time.

programme.title: Moving McAllister
programme.desc: Rick Robinson is a ladder-climbing law intern from Miami with four days until the Bar Exam. Desperate to score points with his boss (McAllister), he commits to a favor he can't afford. He ends up in a rundown truck headed to L.A. with his boss's possessions, his Hollywood-bound niece, and her pet pig. Amidst hitch-hikers, breakdowns, and assorted local yokels, Rick finds love, life and maybe himself in this trans-American road trip from hell.

programme.title: Mary 4 Mayor
programme.desc: Running for mayor against her incumbent mayor father, an eighteen-year-old young woman learns valuable life lessons that not only are the building blocks to saving her family, but also the town she lives in.

programme.title: It's a Fixer Upper
programme.desc: When The Dovers find they're in financial jeopardy, the only answer is to sell the house Anne's parent's left her. But when no one wants to buy it, they decide the only way to get rid of the house is to fix it up.

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: After winning a $50,000 prize, a man decides to pay things forward by buying Christmas gifts for strangers under the pseudonym "Lucky the Elf."

programme.title: The Ugly Christmas Sweater.
programme.desc: Megan hunts for top Christmas hashtag to wow boss and crush at work.

programme.title: HEAVEN SENT
programme.desc: Billy & Maire near 9-year marriage end: Romantic artist and businesswoman.

programme.title: Kill Thy Neighbor
programme.desc: After her husband's death, Julie and her son move near his aunt, Alison, who secretly blames Julie for it.

programme.title: Love Map
programme.desc: A self-assured relationship columnist is sent on assignment with a prickly tour guide to Florida.

programme.title: Inconceivable
programme.desc: A woman interprets a kiss at a high school reunion as an invitation to follow her ex across the country and supplant his current family.

programme.title: I Think I Do
programme.desc: The relationship between three sisters, as one is left at the altar on her wedding day.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) meets the girl of his dreams (Brooklyn Decker) but has to enlist his loyal assistant Katherine (Jennifer Aniston) to pretend to be his soon-to-be ex-wife in order to cover up a careless lie. When more lies backfire, Katherine's kids become involved, and everyone heads off to Hawaii for a ridiculous, out-of-control weekend that tests the limits of how far we'll go for love.

programme.title: Paul Blart
programme.desc: In Columbia Pictures' comedy Paul Blart: Mall Cop, Kevin James stars as the title character, a single, suburban dad, trying to make ends meet as a security officer at a New Jersey mall. Though no one else takes his job seriously, Paul considers himself on the front lines of safety. When a heist shuts down the megaplex, Jersey's most formidable mall cop will have to become a real cop to save the day.

programme.title: Paul Blart
programme.desc: After six years of keeping our malls safe, Paul Blart (Kevin James) has earned a vacation. He heads to Vegas with his teenage daughter and finds that safety never takes a holiday. When duty calls, Blart answers.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: Before You Know It
programme.desc: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star!

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.

programme.title: The Hustle
programme.desc: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is a glamorous, seductive Brit with a penchant for defrauding gullible wealthy men. Into her well-ordered world bursts Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), an Aussie who is as free-form and fun-loving as Josephine is calculated and cunning.

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Mafia loan shark turned Hollywood Producer Chili Palmer in this sharp sequel to "Get Shorty." With an unbelievably hip all-star cast that also includes Uma Thurman, André 3000, Steve Tyler, Christina Milian and The Rock, and bursting with the hottest music in the biz.

programme.title: Django Challenges Sartana
programme.desc: Framed for a bank robbery, bounty killer Django's brother, Steve is lynched.

programme.title: Gunfighters Die Harder
programme.desc: Crooked bankers plan an insurance swindle and hire a Mexican gang to steal the bank's gold but they also pay Lasky's gang to kill the Mexicans.

programme.title: Damned Pistols of Dallas
programme.desc: Outlaw Fast Draw (Álvarez) assaults stagecoach with passengers Clay Stone (Beir), singer Katy Dior (Marandi) and gambler Fred Foster (Mathot), but Stone is ready to take revenge.

programme.title: Return of Shanghai Joe
programme.desc: A sinister town boss called Pat Barnes has exploited almost everyone in the town.

programme.title: A Few Dollars for Django

programme.title: Oscar Peterson Trio, Stuff Smith & Ella Fitzgerald
programme.sub-title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. The Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson and his trio of guitarist Herb Ellis and bassist Ray Brown are later joined by trumpeter Roy Eldridge and drummer Jo Jones. As an added attraction, American violinist Stuff Smith joins the proceedings. American singer Ella Fitzgerald, accompanied by pianist Don Abney, Ellis, Brown and Jones, hits her vocal peak in a stunning set that culminates in a jam session of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) with the entire ensemble.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas
programme.sub-title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler's song-symphony — one of the composer's most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas
programme.sub-title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler's song-symphony — one of the composer's most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Jack Johnson
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Jack Johnson featuring unforgettable version of his hits: 'Better Together', 'Good People', 'Taylor' and many more.

programme.title: Daryl Hall & John Oates
programme.sub-title: Hall & Oates - Live at Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: When Daryl Hall and John Oates took to the stage at Sydney's Entertainment Centre as the iconic bass line of ‘Maneater' began to play, the fans knew they were in for a treat. This duo may have been opening concerts with that irresistibly smooth number for years, but it never seems to lose its magic, and the crowd – an eclectic mix of teens and baby boomers alike – lapped it up. Daryl Hall and John Oates wisely reunited a few years ago after a string of solo projects, and although Oates no longer sports his signature ‘tache, they put on the kind of show that makes it hard to believe they even considered going their separate ways. Earworms like ‘I Can't Go For That', ‘Out Of Touch' and ‘Kiss On My List' were surefire reminders that these guys are absolute hit machines, and their catchy synth-soul classics probably deserve to permeate the airwaves as much today as they did decades ago. These Philly crooners still have it in bucket-loads, so this show should have everyone from diehard Daryl Hall and John Oates fans to kids of the 80's groovin' along in no time.

programme.title: Avril Lavigne

The pop singer rocked the audience to the sound of “Girlfriend” as well as other great hits like “Complicated” and “I'm With You”. El visitante es sin duda un tipo encantador pero Kotov, receloso, pronto descubre el siniestro juego que el hombre ha puesto en marcha.

programme.title: Valmont

programme.title: Mahler. Una sombra en el pasado
programme.desc: Gustav Mahler fue un eminente compositor y director de orquesta. De origen judío, desde muy niño soportó el antisemitismo. Tuvo una salud precaria y una neurosis obsesiva por la muerte. Ya mayor se casó con una mujer joven, culta y muy bella, teniendo un matrimonio apasionado y lleno de conflictos.

programme.title: El velo pintado

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras mujeres
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer próximos a los cuarenta se conocen en una boda en un hotel neoyorkino. Entablarán una conversación llena de ingenio y dobles sentidos en la que cada uno va cercando al otro con la precisión de un felino.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: Viking

Milo (Kit Harington, Jon Snow en 'Juego de Tronos'), un esclavo convertido en gladiador, ve cómo a su amor, la joven Cassia, la obligan a prometerse con Corvus, un corrupto senador. Cuando el Vesubio entra en erupción, Milo intentará salvarla... mientras todo se derrumba.

programme.title: La sombra del pasado

programme.desc: Una madre lucha por cuidar a su bebé mientras el padre se aleja de ellos.

programme.title: La Ola Perfecta
programme.desc: ¿Podrías encontrar a tu amor verdadero haciendo surf?

programme.title: Eva
programme.desc: Un dramaturgo se refugia en un chalet durante una nevada y conoce a una mujer misteriosa.

programme.title: Zoe
programme.desc: Dos compañeros en un revolucionario laboratorio diseñan la tecnología que mejora y perfecciona relaciones románticas. Mientras su trabajo progresa, sus descubrimientos se hacen más profundos.

programme.title: Chungking Express
programme.desc: Dos historias de amor en un popular barrio turístico de Hong Kong. La primera describe el encuentro entre un joven policía y una misteriosa mujer fatal traficante de drogas. La segunda entre un solitario agente de policía y la joven camarera del bar donde aquél suele comer.

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: El sueño de una noche de verano
programme.desc: Enamórate. Diviértete. Comienza una noche mágica... Un reparto estelar en una maravillosa comedia llena de descabelladas pasiones, peligrosas pociones y espíritus traviesos.

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: 1919. La Gran Guerra ha acabado y el Café Rotonde se ha convertido en el refugio de la élite artística: Picasso, Rivera, Stein, Cocteau, Soutine, Modigliani... Esta es la historia jamás contada de la ácida rivalidad entre Picasso y Modigliani, marcada por la genialidad, la arrogancia y las pasiones. Jeanne Hébuterne es una bella católica, cuyo error fue enamorarse de Modigliani, un judío. Tratando de sacar a su familia de la pobreza, el artista se inscribe en el certamen anual de arte y Picasso, guiado por esa rivalidad, hará lo mismo.

programme.title: Aprendiendo a conducir
programme.desc: Wendy es una escritora de Manhattan que decide sacarse el carnet de conducir mientras su matrimonio se disuelve. Para ello recibe clases de Darwan, un hombre de origen indio que se gana la vida como taxista e instructor en una autoescuela. Mientras conducen por las calles de Nueva York, se alejan de sus problemas cotidianos y surge entre ellos una amistad especial.

programme.title: No se lo digas a nadie
programme.desc: El Dr. Alex Beck yace inconsciente mientras su esposa y amor de la infancia Margot es brutalmente asesinada. Ocho años después, Alex todavía no ha superado lo sucedido. Un día recibe un e-mail anónimo con un enlace en el que aparece la imagen en directo de Margot en una multitud. Alex se lanza entonces a una persecución frenética para descubrir la verdad.

programme.title: Elektra Luxx
programme.desc: Elektra Luxx es una estrella del porno cuya vida da un vuelco al descubrir que está embarazada. Inicia entonces una nueva etapa…

programme.title: La Primera Navidad
programme.desc: Un ladrón y un sacerdote viajan 2.000 años atrás y deben encontrar las figuras de la Natividad.

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: El forastero procede de un planeta arrasado por el desorden medioambiental y la lluvia radiactiva.

programme.title: Trinidad y Bambino... (Tal Para Cual)
programme.desc: Trinidad descubre que Bambino fue condenado injustamente y huye con él para buscar a los culpables.

programme.title: Sharknado 4: Que La 4 Te Acompañe
programme.desc: Un extraño Sharknado de arena golpea Las Vegas, Fin vuelve a la acción y lucha contra el Sharknado.

programme.title: El Embajador de la India
programme.desc: Jaime Flórez¸ provinciano astuto y malicioso¸ se ve envuelto en el equívoco en una ciudad colombiana.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Todo el mundo odia a Johan
programme.desc: Johan es un excéntrico e inadaptado habitante de una pequeña aldea noruega. Huérfano desde niño y aficionado a los explosivos, Johan intenta conquistar el corazón de su vecina Solvor, a quien voló por los aires accidentalmente de pequeños.

programme.title: De vuelta a casa
programme.desc: Alice (Reese Witherspoon) es una mujer recién separada que decide enfrentarse a nuevos retos y vuelve a Los Ángeles para construirse una nueva vida. Un nuevo trabajo que no es exactamente lo que ella esperaba, un colegio nuevo para sus hijos y facturas que pagar.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: Coffee Wars
programme.desc: Una barista vegana se enfrenta al mundo en el Campeonato Mundial de Baristas.

programme.title: El Extra
programme.desc: En esta divertida comedia, un extra cinematográfico soñador hace todo lo que está en sus manos para que una joven actriz consiga su oportunidad en el mundo del cine.

programme.title: El Patrullero 777
programme.desc: Cantinflas es un agente de policía que debe mantener el orden en la ciudad, pero la diversión está asegurada cuando las cosas empiezan a desmadrarse.

programme.title: Entrega Inmediata
programme.desc: Mientras trabaja de cartero, una preciosa chica rubia se acerca a Cantinflas y le pide que entregue una carta muy importante en la planta nuclear de la ciudad. Cantinflas está encantado de ser de ayuda, pero no sabe que la chica es una espía y que la carta contiene secretos nucleares codificados.

programme.title: El Clan De Los Rompehuesos
programme.desc: Paul Crewe, un jugador de fútbol americano, y Nate Scarboro, entrenador y antiguo campeón, se encuentran cumpliendo condena en la misma prisión. Juntos deciden formar un equipo que juegue contra el de los guardias.

programme.title: Imperio del crimen
programme.desc: John Sands, un exalguacil de Texas convertido en fugitivo, descubre que su hermano ha sido asesinado misteriosamente en Sentinel. A pesar de la recompensa que pesa sobre él, regresa al Panhandle decidido a descubrir la verdad y encontrar al responsable, mientras el peligro lo acecha en cada paso.

programme.title: Gloriosos camaradas
programme.desc: ¿Qué podría ser peor para dos oficiales de caballería que luchar contra las tribus nativas? Luchar entre sí por la misma mujer.

programme.title: El forajido
programme.desc: Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday y Billy the Kid se enfrentan entre sí por la ley y las atenciones de la vivaz zorra campesina Río McDonald.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 48, 49
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Haz caso a tu corazón
programme.desc: Un cantautor se enamora de una chica que no puede escuchar la música que ella le inspira.

programme.title: Toque de Queda
programme.desc: Es una película guatemalteca que narra cómo los vecinos de Villas de la Esperanza, acechados por la eventual invasión de violentos, deciden armarse y patrullar de noche, dispuestos a defender con su vida sus hogares y familias.

programme.title: Devuélveme La Vida
programme.desc: Una jovencita lucha sin cesar para salvar a su madre drogadicta de un peligroso inframundo mientras el Departamento de la Policía de Los Ángeles lucha por destruir ese mundo.

programme.title: Mi Angelito Favorito
programme.desc: Un ángel es enviado a la Tierra en varias ocasiones y no consigue ningún cambio positivo. A pesar de sus fracasos, el ángel regresa a la República Dominicana e intenta ayudar a la gente.

programme.title: Encontrando el amor en Big Sky
programme.desc: Paisley, independiente y decidida, trabaja con su ex Josh para salvar el rancho de su abuelo. Con la ayuda de Sam, su amigo y hermano de Josh, enfrentan desafíos y, tras 15 años, reconectan y redescubren un amor que siempre estuvo presente mientras luchan por recaudar fondos.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando la guerra empiece
programme.desc: Cuando su país es invadido y sus familias secuestradas, ocho adolescentes se unen para luchar.

programme.title: Bienvenido a casa
programme.desc: Aún de luto por la muerte de su esposa, Bruno está irremediablemente apegado a la cabaña junto al mar que construyeron juntos. Cuando es desalojado por sus desalmados suegros, Bruno promete recuperarlo a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela Louis De Bernieres basada en un hecho real, narra como un perro kelpie australiano se une a una comunidad minera durante los años setenta.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando la guerra empiece
programme.desc: Cuando su país es invadido y sus familias secuestradas, ocho adolescentes se unen para luchar.

programme.title: Re-emigrantes
programme.desc: Los Briones deciden regresar a su pueblo de origen, Villanueva de los Molinos, Una vez allí, Santiago, y sus hijos tratarán de adaptarse a su nueva vida realizando todo tipo de trabajos.

programme.title: La Cima
programme.desc: Mateo (Javier Rey) se enfrenta por primera vez a la montaña más peligrosa del planeta, el Annapurna, con el reto de llegar hasta la cima y cumplir así una antigua promesa. En su ascenso sufre un accidente que le deja inconsciente y gravemente herido.

programme.title: La Mujer sin Piano
programme.desc: Un ama de casa casada para la que no hay nada comparable a la íntima satisfacción de ver el plato humeante servido con admirable puntualidad a la hora de la comida. Veinticuatro horas de su vida de la que una noche decide escapar, y cuenta todo lo que le pasa en esta fuga.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Alpha son tres jóvenes amigos criminales que se separaron en un momento determinado de su vida debido a un robo fallido. Ocho años después vuelven a estar juntos, cada uno eligiendo diferentes estilos de vida.

programme.title: Lobo Generacion AKA Generation Wolf (TV Cut)
programme.desc: Un joven emprendedor recurre a medidas desesperadas para salvar su negocio, pero ¿los suenos de este ambicioso Lobo lo sacaran del bosque o lo enjaularan para siempre?

programme.title: The Perfect Husband
programme.desc: A married couple decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin, but the romantic journey takes a turn for the worse, when a sneaking suspicion becomes pure madness.

programme.title: Qué Pelo Más Guay
programme.desc: Un traficante de drogas de poca monta se topa con un baño que lo hace retroceder en el tiempo.

programme.title: Los 28 hombres de Panfilov
programme.desc: Rusia, noviembre 1941. Las tropas alemanas se acercan a Moscú. En los alrededores de la ciudad un grupo de 28 soldados del Ejército Rojo de la división 316, bajo el mando del general Ivan Panfilov, trata de detener el avance de la 11 División Panzer, compuesta por 54 tanques y numerosas tropas del ejército nazi.

programme.title: Asesino de tiburones
programme.desc: Los servicios del asesino de tiburones Chase Walker han sido contratados por su hermano Jake, jefe de una banda criminal de la Costa Oeste. El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: H4zard
programme.desc: Sigue a Noah, quien realmente ama a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero después de aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que podría costarle la vida, su familia o su querido automóvil.

programme.title: Exoplaneta Dune en Peligro
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: Eye of the beast: El monstruo del lago
programme.desc: Un joven científico llega a un pequeño pueblo pesquero para luchar contra la criatura que vive bajo el agua.

programme.title: El Comando
programme.desc: Un agente de la DEA que sufre un trastorno de estrés postraumático debe proteger a su familia de un ataque a su casa después de que un delincuente convicto y sus secuaces vengan a buscar su alijo de millones dentro de la casa del agente.

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: ¿Es posible viajar en el tiempo para evitar una catástrofe? El capitán Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) tiene la difícil misión de conseguirlo en esta eficaz película de acción y ciencia-ficción considerada como una de las mejores películas del género de los últimos años.

programme.title: El Barón Rojo
programme.desc: Película biográfica que narra partes de la vida del mítico as de la aviación de la Primera Guerra Mundial Manfred von Richthofen, cuya habilidad y hazañas le llevó a convertirse en una leyenda durante esa contienda, temido por sus adversarios.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente I
programme.desc: Joshua McCord es un agente del servicio secreto retirado al que le encargan la misión de entrenar a un joven. Sin embargo, cuando la Primera Dama es secuestrada por terroristas, se encuentra inmerso en una misión de 'todo o nada'.

programme.title: Escape
programme.desc: 1363. La Muerte Negra ha aniquilado a la mitad de la población. Muchos huyen de la muerte y la miseria en busca de una vida mejor en otro lugar. Pero el campo está densamente poblado. Y, en las montañas, bandas de ladrones hacen de la vida algo efímero.

programme.title: Altitud
programme.desc: Una agente del FBI es castigada y enviada a un trabajo de administrativa en Washington DC después de desobedecer a sus mandos en una negociación con rehenes. En el avión que le lleva a Washington conoce a un apuesto hombre de negocios que le ofrece una recompensa si le ayuda a bajar del avión.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: Jack Justice es un policía que está suspendido de la fuerza policial debido a sus acciones imprudentes.

programme.title: Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Dos equipos de buscadores de tesoros realizan una excavación ilegal en la isla de Corregidor, Filipinas.

programme.title: Winter War
programme.desc: En la II GM, el teniente Robert Cappa y su pelotón defienden una posición vital del último ataque nazi.

programme.title: Terms & Conditions
programme.desc: El asesino a sueldo Vet Jones recibe un ultimátum de su antiguo jefe: mata al objetivo o muere su hijo.

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: Un cerebro criminal se enfrenta a un oficial retirado.

programme.title: Una Relación Peligrosa
programme.desc: El delincuente de poca monta Gigli (Ben Affleck) es famoso por sus grandes meteduras de pata. Ricki (Jennifer Lopez) es una gánster con temperamento. Cuando emprenden juntos una misión que se descontrola a lo grande, ¿acabarán resolviendo sus diferencias personales y poniendo remedio a su atracción mutua? Dirigida por Martin Brest (Scent of a Woman), ¡GIGLI es una comedia romántica de alto voltaje que te hará entrar en calor!

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) sigue un rastro de pistas a través de Europa con Sienna Brooks (Felicity Jones) para detener un virus que acabaría con la mitad de la población mundial.

programme.title: El Último Gran Héroe
programme.desc: El joven Danny Madigan vive obsesionado con Jack Slater, el mayor héroe de las películas de acción de la historia, y a menudo sueña con vivir alguna de sus increíbles aventuras. La última de Jack va a ser estrenada y uno de los acomodadores del cine, conocedor de la admiración que el chico siente por su héroe, le regala una entrada para verla. Un ticket que resulta ser mágico y permite al adolescente cruzar la pantalla y protagonizar la película junto a su admirado.
